ModInfo.Name: FF8 Steam Deck Button Glyphs
ModInfo.Author: todi
ModInfo.Description:
Shows the Steam Deck buttons (A, B, X, Y, L1/R1, L2/R2, View, Menu) wherever FF8 names a button, instead of "B1", "B2", ... The icons follow your button setup from the in-game Config menu.
Requires the English Steam version of FF8 with Junction VIII.
Using AxlRose's mod with its UI? Place this mod above it in the list.
ModInfo.ReleaseNotes: 0.8: textures only, the Timber train keypad fix (DLL) is removed. 0.7: first public release.
